blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.en: Section Contents

blocks.zh: Process Performance Qualification — Overview | 製程效能確效概述
blocks.en: Process Performance Qualification — Overview

blocks.zh: 中文解說 | Commentary
blocks.en: Commentary

blocks.zh: PPQ 的核心目的
blocks.en: Core Purpose of PPQ

blocks.zh: PPQ（製程效能確效）是驗證「滅菌製程在實際裝載條件下，能否持續、穩定地達到設計標準」的關鍵步驟。它回答的問題是：設計好的循環，放到真實產品上，還管用嗎？
blocks.en: PPQ (Process Performance Qualification) is the key step that confirms the sterilization process can consistently and reliably meet its design criteria under actual load conditions. It answers one question: does the cycle we designed still work on real product?

blocks.zh: 兩大元素：物理 vs 生物
blocks.en: Two Elements: Physical vs Biological

blocks.zh: 物理確效（Physical Qualification）：用溫度探頭（thermocouple）量測每個位置的熱輸入量，計算 Fphys，確認熱能均勻分佈。
blocks.en: Physical Qualification: Thermocouples measure the heat input at each location to calculate Fphys and confirm that heat energy is evenly distributed.

blocks.zh: 生物確效（Biological Qualification）：用生物指示劑（BI）驗證實際殺菌效果，計算 Fbio。兩者必須相互一致。
blocks.en: Biological Qualification: Biological indicators (BIs) verify the actual lethality and Fbio is calculated. The two must be consistent with each other.

blocks.zh: 比喻：烤箱確效
blocks.en: Analogy: Qualifying an Oven

blocks.zh: 物理確效好比用溫度計確認烤箱內各點溫度均勻；生物確效則是真的把食物放進去，確認中心也熟透了。兩者缺一不可。
blocks.en: Physical qualification is like using a thermometer to confirm that every spot in the oven is at the same temperature; biological qualification is actually putting food in and confirming the center is cooked through. You need both.

blocks.zh: PPQ 前置條件
blocks.en: PPQ Prerequisites

blocks.zh: PPQ 不是第一步！必須先完成：DQ → IQ → OQ（設備資格）、蒸汽品質確認、儀器校正、裝載定義，才能進行 PPQ。
blocks.en: PPQ is not the first step! Before PPQ you must complete DQ → IQ → OQ (equipment qualification), steam quality confirmation, instrument calibration and load definition.

blocks.zh: 三次連續合格
blocks.en: Three Consecutive Successful Runs

blocks.zh: 初次確效需要至少三次連續可接受的運行，才能確認製程的再現性（repeatability）。這是監管標準，不可省略。
blocks.en: Initial qualification requires at least three consecutive acceptable runs to confirm process repeatability. This is a regulatory expectation and cannot be skipped.

blocks.zh: 關鍵術語
blocks.en: Key Terms

blocks.zh: PPQ：製程效能確效
blocks.en: PPQ: Process Performance Qualification

blocks.zh: MAC：最低可接受循環（Minimum Acceptable Cycle）
blocks.en: MAC: Minimum Acceptable Cycle

blocks.zh: Fphys：物理量測所得的 F 值
blocks.en: Fphys: F value obtained from physical measurements

blocks.zh: Fbio：生物確效所得的 F 值
blocks.en: Fbio: F value obtained from biological qualification

blocks.zh: BI：生物指示劑（Biological Indicator）
blocks.en: BI: Biological Indicator

blocks.zh: Physical Qualification | 物理確效
blocks.en: Physical Qualification

blocks.zh: 溫度分佈 vs 熱穿透：兩個不同問題
blocks.en: Temperature Distribution vs Heat Penetration: Two Different Questions

blocks.zh: 溫度分佈（Temperature Distribution）：腔室各點的加熱媒介（蒸汽）分佈是否均勻？探頭不觸碰產品，量測空間中的蒸汽。
blocks.en: Temperature Distribution: Is the heating medium (steam) evenly distributed throughout the chamber? The probes do not touch the product; they measure the steam in the chamber space.

blocks.zh: 熱穿透（Heat Penetration）：熱能有沒有確實傳入產品或物品內部？探頭放在最難加熱的位置（冷點）。
blocks.en: Heat Penetration: Does the heat actually reach the inside of the product or article? The probes are placed at the most difficult-to-heat location (the cold spot).

blocks.zh: 比喻：浴室暖氣
blocks.en: Analogy: Bathroom Heater

blocks.zh: 溫度分佈確效 = 確認浴室各角落溫度一致（空氣中量測）；熱穿透確效 = 確認毛巾中心也暖了（接觸物品量測）。
blocks.en: Temperature distribution qualification = confirming that every corner of the bathroom is at the same temperature (measured in the air); heat penetration qualification = confirming that the center of the towel is warm too (measured in contact with the item).

blocks.zh: 探頭放置原則
blocks.en: Probe Placement Principles

blocks.zh: 溫度分佈探頭：不接觸產品，放在腔室空間中
blocks.en: Temperature distribution probes: Do not touch the product; placed in the chamber space

blocks.zh: 熱穿透探頭：放在「最難加熱的位置」（冷點）——液體最大容器中心、多孔硬物品最深處
blocks.en: Heat penetration probes: Placed at the "most difficult-to-heat location" (cold spot) — the center of the largest liquid container, or the deepest point of a porous/hard article

blocks.zh: 所有探頭位置必須附圖並記錄選擇理由
blocks.en: All probe locations must be documented in a diagram together with the rationale for their selection

blocks.zh: 均衡時間（Equilibration Time）
blocks.en: Equilibration Time

blocks.zh: 從達到設定溫度到整個裝載均勻達到該溫度所需的時間。均衡時間過長是常見的失敗原因，也是可接受標準的重要項目。
blocks.en: The time from reaching the set temperature until the entire load has uniformly reached that temperature. Excessive equilibration time is a common cause of failure and an important item in the acceptance criteria.

blocks.zh: F0 分佈（F0 Distribution）
blocks.en: F0 Distribution

blocks.zh: 物理確效的核心輸出之一：計算裝載中每個探頭位置的累積 F<sub>0</sub> 值，並確認最低 F<sub>0</sub>（最冷點）仍然滿足設計要求（MAC）。F<sub>0</sub> 分佈越窄，代表熱輸入越均勻。
blocks.en: One of the core outputs of physical qualification: calculate the cumulative F<sub>0</sub> at each probe location in the load and confirm that the lowest F<sub>0</sub> (the coldest spot) still meets the design requirement (MAC). The narrower the F<sub>0</sub> distribution, the more uniform the heat input.

blocks.zh: 思考練習 1
blocks.en: Exercise 1

blocks.zh: 若一個液體裝載含有 20 瓶 100 mL 和 5 瓶 500 mL，您的熱穿透探頭應優先放在哪裡？為什麼？探頭數量如何決定？
blocks.en: If a liquid load contains 20 bottles of 100 mL and 5 bottles of 500 mL, where should your heat penetration probes be placed first, and why? How is the number of probes determined?

blocks.zh: Biological Qualification | 生物確效
blocks.en: Biological Qualification

blocks.zh: 生物確效的邏輯
blocks.en: The Logic of Biological Qualification

blocks.zh: 生物確效用「故意放入已知數量的耐熱孢子（BI）」然後「用最低可接受循環（MAC）去殺它」，若達到預定的對數減少（log reduction），即代表製程可提供足夠致死量。
blocks.en: Biological qualification deliberately introduces a known number of heat-resistant spores (BIs) and then challenges them with the Minimum Acceptable Cycle (MAC). If the predetermined log reduction is achieved, the process delivers sufficient lethality.

blocks.zh: BI 設計公式記憶法
blocks.en: A Way to Remember the BI Design Formula

blocks.zh:
殺完後剩多少 = -（F ÷ D）+ 原始數量（對數）

想要確效 F = 8 min：
→ 用 D = 2 min 的 BI
→ 需要 4 個 log 的 reduction (8/2=4)
→ 若 N_0 = 10^6，則 N_F ≤ 10^2 才合格
blocks.en:
Survivors after the cycle = −(F ÷ D) + initial population (in logs)

To qualify F = 8 min:
→ Use a BI with D = 2 min
→ A 4-log reduction is needed (8/2 = 4)
→ If N_0 = 10^6, then N_F ≤ 10^2 to pass

blocks.zh: 比喻：用擋風玻璃考驗安全氣囊
blocks.en: Analogy: Testing an Airbag with a Crash Test

blocks.zh: 如果你知道安全氣囊在 40 G 以上才爆開，你就用 40 G 的衝擊測試它。BI 設計也是：已知要達到 F = 12 min，就設計一個需要 12 min 才能殺完的 BI。
blocks.en: If you know the airbag deploys above 40 G, you test it with a 40 G impact. BI design works the same way: if the target is F = 12 min, design a BI that takes 12 min to kill.

blocks.zh: BI 放置策略
blocks.en: BI Placement Strategy

blocks.zh: 液體裝載：BI 接種入密封容器，放在裝載各點（包含冷點），旁邊放熱穿透探頭。
blocks.en: Liquid loads: Inoculate BIs into sealed containers and place them at various locations in the load (including the cold spot), next to the heat penetration probes.

blocks.zh: 多孔/硬物裝載：BI 放在最難滅菌的位置：
blocks.en: Porous/hard article loads: Place BIs at the most difficult-to-sterilize locations:

blocks.zh: 過濾器摺疊處內部
blocks.en: Inside filter pleats

blocks.zh: 管路中心（可能有空氣殘留）
blocks.en: The center of tubing (where air may remain)

blocks.zh: 橡膠塞中（蒸汽難穿透）
blocks.en: Inside rubber stoppers (steam penetrates with difficulty)

blocks.zh: BI 盡量與熱穿透探頭相鄰，以建立 F<sub>phys</sub> 與 F<sub>bio</sub> 的相關性。
blocks.en: Place BIs as close as possible to the heat penetration probes to establish the correlation between F<sub>phys</sub> and F<sub>bio</sub>.

blocks.zh: 代用液（Surrogate）的使用時機
blocks.en: When to Use a Surrogate Fluid

blocks.zh: 若產品本身含有防腐劑或抗菌劑（會抑制 BI 生長），必須改用代用液（surrogate fluid）作為懸浮介質，並通過抑制性研究（growth inhibition study）來支持該決定。
blocks.en: If the product itself contains a preservative or antimicrobial agent (which would inhibit BI growth), a surrogate fluid must be used as the suspension medium, and the decision must be supported by a growth inhibition study.

blocks.zh: 思考練習 2
blocks.en: Exercise 2

blocks.zh: 您的 overkill 循環目標 F<sub>0</sub> ≥ 12 min。如果選用 D = 1.5 min 的 BI，要求全殺（N<sub>F</sub> < 1），請計算最低需要多少 N<sub>0</sub>？
blocks.en: Your overkill cycle targets F<sub>0</sub> ≥ 12 min. If you select a BI with D = 1.5 min and require total kill (N<sub>F</sub> < 1), calculate the minimum N<sub>0</sub> required.

blocks.zh: （提示：Log N0 = Log 10-1 + F/D = -1 + 12/1.5）
blocks.en: (Hint: Log N0 = Log 10-1 + F/D = -1 + 12/1.5)

blocks.zh: Process Performance Acceptance Criteria | 製程效能可接受標準
blocks.en: Process Performance Acceptance Criteria

blocks.zh: 可接受標準的設計原則
blocks.en: Design Principles for Acceptance Criteria

blocks.zh: 所有可接受標準必須在執行前寫入測試計畫（protocol）。事後回頭修改標準是 GMP 重大違規。標準需基於：產品類型、滅菌方法、法規要求、以及循環開發中確定的操作參數。
blocks.en: All acceptance criteria must be written into the protocol before execution. Changing criteria after the fact is a serious GMP violation. Criteria should be based on the product type, the sterilization method, regulatory requirements and the operating parameters established during cycle development.

blocks.zh: F<sub>phys</sub> 與 F<sub>bio</sub> 一致性
blocks.en: Consistency of F<sub>phys</sub> and F<sub>bio</sub>

blocks.zh: PPQ 的最終驗收要求物理與生物數據相互一致（general agreement）。若兩者不一致（例如物理 F0 高但 BI 未被殺死），代表可能有蒸汽穿透問題，需深入調查。
blocks.en: Final acceptance of PPQ requires the physical and biological data to be in general agreement. If they disagree (for example, a high physical F0 but BIs that were not killed), there may be a steam penetration problem that requires thorough investigation.

blocks.zh: SAL 目標與 F<sub>0</sub> 最低值
blocks.en: SAL Target and Minimum F<sub>0</sub>

blocks.zh: 對於 overkill 設計，標準要求 F<sub>0</sub> ≥ 12 min（對應 SAL = 10<sup>-6</sup>）；對於產品特異性設計，最低 F<sub>0</sub> 由產品生物負荷數據及 D 值計算決定，無固定最低值，但通常需滿足 SAL ≤ 10<sup>-6</sup>。
blocks.en: For an overkill design, the criterion is F<sub>0</sub> ≥ 12 min (corresponding to SAL = 10<sup>-6</sup>). For a product-specific design, the minimum F<sub>0</sub> is determined from the product bioburden data and D value; there is no fixed minimum, but SAL ≤ 10<sup>-6</sup> must generally be met.

blocks.zh: Sterilizer Equivalence | 滅菌器等效性
blocks.en: Sterilizer Equivalence

blocks.zh: 什麼是滅菌器等效性？
blocks.en: What Is Sterilizer Equivalence?

blocks.zh: 若工廠有兩台或多台設計相似的滅菌器，可透過等效性研究證明它們的性能一致，從而減少重複確效的工作量。例如：三台相同型號的滅菌器，可能只需對其中一台做完整 PPQ，另外兩台做簡化確效，前提是能證明等效性。
blocks.en: If a facility has two or more sterilizers of similar design, an equivalence study can demonstrate that their performance is the same, thereby reducing the repeated qualification workload. For example, with three identical sterilizers, a full PPQ might be performed on only one and reduced qualification on the other two, provided equivalence can be demonstrated.

blocks.zh: 等效性的前提條件
blocks.en: Prerequisites for Equivalence

blocks.zh: 所有滅菌器必須先各自完成 IQ/OQ，並符合操作參數標準
blocks.en: All sterilizers must first complete their own IQ/OQ and meet the operating parameter criteria

blocks.zh: 設計必須「相似」（similar design），包括公用設施供應
blocks.en: The designs must be "similar", including utility supply

blocks.zh: 需要風險評估（risk assessment）支持
blocks.en: Supported by a risk assessment

blocks.zh: 某些情況下（如縮減確效運行次數）可能需要法規批准
blocks.en: In some cases (such as a reduced number of qualification runs), regulatory approval may be required

blocks.zh: 比喻：連鎖餐廳廚房
blocks.en: Analogy: Chain Restaurant Kitchens

blocks.zh: 如果三間分店廚房設備完全相同，廚師按同一份 SOP 操作，那麼在一間驗證成功後，其餘兩間的驗證工作可以簡化——但前提是能證明三間的設備性能確實一致。
blocks.en: If three branch kitchens have identical equipment and the chefs follow the same SOP, then once one is validated successfully, the validation effort for the other two can be simplified — provided you can show that the equipment performance in all three really is the same.

blocks.zh: 等效性比較的五大要素
blocks.en: The Five Elements of an Equivalence Comparison

blocks.zh: 關鍵與次關鍵參數（溫度、壓力、時間）
blocks.en: Critical and non-critical parameters (temperature, pressure, time)

blocks.zh: 溫度分佈
blocks.en: Temperature distribution

blocks.zh: 熱穿透
blocks.en: Heat penetration

blocks.zh: F<sub>0</sub> 範圍
blocks.en: F<sub>0</sub> range

blocks.zh: 微生物滅活結果
blocks.en: Microbial inactivation results

blocks.zh: Bracketing | 括弧策略
blocks.en: Bracketing

blocks.zh: 括弧策略的核心邏輯
blocks.en: The Core Logic of Bracketing

blocks.zh: 如果你能確認「最極端的情況都通過了」，中間的情況自然也會通過。括弧策略的關鍵是：科學地識別最差情況（worst case），並加以確效。
blocks.en: If you can confirm that the most extreme case passes, the cases in between will naturally pass as well. The key to bracketing is to scientifically identify the worst case and qualify it.

blocks.zh: 比喻：橋樑載重測試
blocks.en: Analogy: Bridge Load Testing

blocks.zh: 若橋樑設計能承受最大載重（滿載卡車），小轎車自然也安全。括弧策略就是：驗證最重的卡車通過，就代表所有較輕的車也通過。
blocks.en: If a bridge is designed to carry the maximum load (a fully loaded truck), a passenger car is naturally safe too. Bracketing works the same way: verifying that the heaviest truck passes means all lighter vehicles pass.

blocks.zh: 單端 vs 雙端括弧
blocks.en: Single-Ended vs Two-Ended Bracketing

blocks.zh: 單端括弧（Single-ended bracket）：只確效一個最差情況（例如只確效最大容器）。適用於較簡單的情況。
blocks.en: Single-ended bracket: Qualify only one worst case (for example, only the largest container). Suitable for simpler situations.

blocks.zh: 雙端括弧（Two-ended bracket）：確效兩個極端（例如最大容器 + 最小容器），中間的容器自動涵蓋。需要的科學依據更充分，但覆蓋面更廣。
blocks.en: Two-ended bracket: Qualify the two extremes (for example, the largest and the smallest container), and the containers in between are automatically covered. This requires stronger scientific justification but gives broader coverage.

blocks.zh: 最小裝載也需確效
blocks.en: The Minimum Load Must Also Be Qualified

blocks.zh: 一個常見誤區：最小裝載因為「物品少」而被認為容易滅菌。但對於沒有固定升溫速率的滅菌器，最小裝載熱容量低，可能比最大裝載更快升溫，導致曝露時間可能不足（過衝風險）。因此也需要挑戰並確效。
blocks.en: A common misconception: the minimum load is considered easy to sterilize because it has "fewer items". But for sterilizers without a fixed heat-up rate, the minimum load has a low heat capacity and may heat up faster than the maximum load, so the exposure time may be insufficient (overshoot risk). It therefore also needs to be challenged and qualified.

blocks.zh: 思考練習 3
blocks.en: Exercise 3

blocks.zh: 您的工廠生產三種規格的玻璃瓶（2 mL、10 mL、50 mL），填充量分別為 1.5 mL、8 mL、45 mL。使用雙端括弧策略，您需要確效哪幾個組合？為什麼 10 mL 瓶可以豁免？如果其中 50 mL 瓶確效失敗，10 mL 瓶是否仍可放行？
blocks.en: Your facility produces glass vials in three sizes (2 mL, 10 mL, 50 mL) with fill volumes of 1.5 mL, 8 mL and 45 mL respectively. Using a two-ended bracketing strategy, which combinations do you need to qualify? Why can the 10 mL vial be exempted? If the 50 mL vial fails qualification, can the 10 mL vial still be released?

blocks.zh: Section 5 Summary | 本節重點總覽
blocks.en: Section 5 Summary

blocks.zh: 關鍵考點整理 | Key Exam Points
blocks.en: Key Exam Points

blocks.zh: PPQ 結構記憶
blocks.en: PPQ Structure Recap

blocks.zh: PPQ = 物理確效 + 生物確效，缺一不可
blocks.en: PPQ = physical qualification + biological qualification; you need both

blocks.zh: 物理確效：溫度分佈（空間）+ 熱穿透（產品）
blocks.en: Physical qualification: temperature distribution (space) + heat penetration (product)

blocks.zh: 生物確效：BI 系統設計 + 放置 + 對數減少驗證
blocks.en: Biological qualification: BI system design + placement + verification of log reduction

blocks.zh: 三次連續合格 = 初次確效完成
blocks.en: Three consecutive successful runs = initial qualification complete

blocks.zh: BI 設計公式快速回顧
blocks.en: Quick Review of the BI Design Formula

blocks.zh: 全殺：N<sub>F</sub> = 10<sup>-1</sup>（= 0 存活者，理論上）
blocks.en: Total kill: N<sub>F</sub> = 10<sup>-1</sup> (= 0 survivors, theoretically)

blocks.zh: D 值越高 → 需要更多 N<sub>0</sub> 才能合法確效目標 F
blocks.en: The higher the D value → the more N<sub>0</sub> is needed to legitimately qualify the target F

blocks.zh: 整合思考練習
blocks.en: Integrated Exercises

blocks.zh: 一家 CDMO 同時生產 A 產品（液體，20 mL 瓶）和 B 產品（粉末，玻璃瓶），兩種產品在同一台滅菌器中滅菌。
blocks.en: A CDMO sterilizes Product A (liquid, 20 mL vials) and Product B (powder, glass vials) in the same sterilizer.

blocks.zh: A 和 B 產品各自需要獨立的 PPQ 嗎？為什麼？
blocks.en: Do Products A and B each need an independent PPQ? Why?

blocks.zh: 如果工廠有兩台相同型號的滅菌器（S1 和 S2），可以用 S1 的 PPQ 代替 S2 嗎？需要滿足什麼條件？
blocks.en: If the facility has two identical sterilizers (S1 and S2), can the PPQ of S1 replace that of S2? What conditions must be met?

blocks.zh: A 產品新增了 50 mL 規格，您選擇用括弧策略涵蓋。需要驗證哪些組合？
blocks.en: A 50 mL size is added to Product A and you choose to cover it with a bracketing strategy. Which combinations must be qualified?
